_meta.description: Past IT support ticket archive. Most cases are resolved, with a small fraction in non-resolved terminal states (user_abandoned, could_not_reproduce) to reflect realistic ServiceNow archive distribution. The agent's search_history tool defaults to filtering only resolved cases. The first 3 entries are key hooks for demo scenarios.

history.issue_summary: VPN client disconnects every 10-15 minutes when working from home on residential cable internet
diagnosis_path: Confirmed VPN service status was operational (no global incident)
Asked about home network type — residential cable, ISP Comcast
Reviewed disconnect interval pattern (regular 10-15 min cadence indicates MTU rather than DHCP)
Tested by setting VPN client MTU to 1300
history.root_cause: MTU mismatch between VPN tunnel default (1500) and the user's residential ISP path which has effective MTU around 1400 due to PPPoE encapsulation overhead. Large packets get fragmented or dropped, causing the VPN to renegotiate and eventually time out.
history.resolution: Set VPN client MTU to 1300 in advanced settings; restart VPN client. Disconnects stopped immediately and stayed stable across an 8-hour workday.

history.issue_summary: Salesforce loading extremely slowly for the entire Chicago office team
diagnosis_path: Checked Salesforce trust.salesforce.com status page — degraded for Midwest region
Confirmed multiple users in the same office reporting identical symptoms
Identified upstream regional CDN issue (no internal action required)
history.root_cause: Regional Salesforce CDN node degradation in the Midwest. Affected all customers routed through the Chicago edge.
history.resolution: Communicated known incident to affected users. Provided VPN East routing as a workaround for users with urgent client-facing work. Salesforce ops resolved within 4 hours.

history.issue_summary: Jenkins jobs timing out and Tableau reports stale starting the morning after a maintenance window
diagnosis_path: Confirmed maintenance window had occurred the prior evening
Checked Jenkins job logs — timeouts occurred specifically when fetching artifacts from internal Maven mirror
Cross-referenced change ticket — firewall allow-list had been tightened
Identified Jenkins agent egress IPs as missing from the new allow-list
Escalated to DevOps for firewall rule restoration
history.root_cause: Maintenance-window firewall rule change inadvertently removed Jenkins agent egress allowance to internal Maven and PyPI mirrors. Jobs hung on artifact fetch until socket timeout. Tableau staleness was a downstream effect of upstream pipeline failure.
history.resolution: DevOps restored the firewall allow-list entry for Jenkins agent egress. Pipeline rerun completed successfully within 30 minutes. Tableau extracts refreshed within 2 hours of the fix.

history.issue_summary: Forgot password to corporate SSO; user requested password reset
diagnosis_path: Verified user identity via security questions
Pointed user to sso.acme.com/reset
history.resolution: Self-service reset via sso.acme.com/reset succeeded.

history.issue_summary: Account locked after multiple failed Okta login attempts
diagnosis_path: Verified lockout via Okta admin console
Confirmed lockout reason was failed-attempt threshold, not credential-stuffing pattern
history.root_cause: User mistyped password 5 times; auto-locked by Okta lockout policy
history.resolution: IAM verified identity and unlocked account. Recommended user enable browser password manager.

history.issue_summary: VPN connects but cannot reach internal Jira
diagnosis_path: Confirmed VPN connected
Tested ping to internal Jira host — failed
Identified split-tunnel route missing for internal subnet
history.root_cause: Split-tunnel routing config did not include the new internal Jira subnet after a recent migration
history.resolution: Pushed updated VPN client config with full internal subnet list; user reconnected and access restored.

history.issue_summary: Mobile MFA token not generating codes after phone replacement
diagnosis_path: Confirmed user had replaced phone
Verified Okta MFA registration tied to old device
history.resolution: Escalated to IAM. After in-person identity verification, IAM reset MFA enrollment.

history.issue_summary: Snowflake production read access requested for new data analyst
diagnosis_path: Verified user is a member of Data Analytics team
Routed access request through standard governance flow
history.resolution: Manager approved; data owner (Director of Data Platform) approved; access granted via standard Okta group membership.

history.issue_summary: Grafana read-only access requested for SRE team member
diagnosis_path: Verified team membership via HR system
history.resolution: User self-served via internal access portal; Okta group `grafana-readers` membership granted automatically after team-membership check passed.

history.issue_summary: Slack search returning no results across all channels
diagnosis_path: Checked Slack status page — global search index rebuild in progress
Confirmed via Slack admin
history.root_cause: Slack-side index rebuild after data-center migration
history.resolution: Communicated to user; resolved by Slack within 6 hours.

history.issue_summary: Zoom audio not working during meetings on macOS
diagnosis_path: Verified macOS microphone permissions for Zoom were revoked after OS update
history.root_cause: macOS Sequoia update reset Zoom microphone permission
history.resolution: Re-enabled microphone permission in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone.

history.issue_summary: Outlook calendar not syncing with Google Workspace
diagnosis_path: Confirmed Google Workspace was the source of truth
Outlook was using cached IMAP profile
history.resolution: Removed Outlook account profile and re-added via Google Workspace OAuth.

history.issue_summary: Cannot install Adobe Creative Cloud — license unavailable
diagnosis_path: Confirmed Adobe license pool was exhausted
history.resolution: Escalated to IT Procurement; new license provisioned next business day.

history.issue_summary: MacBook Pro not charging — battery indicator shows fault
diagnosis_path: Tried alternate USB-C cable and adapter — issue persisted
Apple diagnostics indicated battery service required
history.resolution: IT Hardware replaced battery via Apple authorized service.

history.issue_summary: Office Wi-Fi extremely slow on certain floors
diagnosis_path: Confirmed multiple users on the same floor reported issue
Network team identified rogue access point causing channel interference
history.root_cause: Unauthorized AP brought in by external vendor
history.resolution: Removed rogue AP; Wi-Fi performance restored.

history.issue_summary: Email not sending — stuck in outbox
diagnosis_path: Verified attachment size — exceeded 25 MB Gmail limit
history.resolution: Recommended Google Drive link sharing instead of attachment.

history.issue_summary: Printer not appearing in print dialog after macOS update
diagnosis_path: Confirmed printer driver may have been removed by macOS update
Sent user a follow-up asking to confirm whether reinstalling the HP driver resolved the issue
Sent second follow-up after 48 hours; no response
Auto-closed per 5-day inactivity policy
history.root_cause: Unconfirmed — user stopped responding before reproduction could be confirmed.
history.resolution: No further response from user after two follow-up requests. Ticket auto-closed per 5-day inactivity SLA.

history.issue_summary: GitHub access lost after team transfer
diagnosis_path: Confirmed user was removed from old team's GitHub org membership
New team membership not yet provisioned
history.resolution: New manager added user to current team's GitHub org.

history.issue_summary: BitLocker recovery key needed for Windows laptop
diagnosis_path: Verified user identity
Retrieved key from corporate key escrow
history.root_cause: TPM reset triggered BitLocker recovery prompt
history.resolution: Provided recovery key from escrow; instructed user on backup procedure.

history.issue_summary: DNS resolution intermittently failing on corporate VPN
diagnosis_path: Confirmed VPN service operational
Tested DNS resolution against internal resolvers — intermittent timeouts
Identified secondary DNS resolver was unreachable
history.root_cause: Failed secondary internal DNS resolver; VPN clients fell back inconsistently
history.resolution: Network team brought secondary resolver back online; refreshed DNS clients.

history.issue_summary: Tableau dashboard shows blank charts after data source change
diagnosis_path: Verified data source had changed schema
Confirmed dashboard had not been republished
history.resolution: Dashboard owner republished with updated schema mapping.

history.issue_summary: Cannot connect to office Wi-Fi after laptop reimage
diagnosis_path: Confirmed laptop was reimaged earlier the same day
Began drafting MDM 802.1X enrollment profile push
User reported back that Wi-Fi connected on its own after a few reboots before any agent action was taken
Closed as transient; no intervention applied
history.root_cause: Could not reproduce — most likely a transient 802.1X enrollment race that self-corrected on next reconnect.
history.resolution: Issue self-resolved before troubleshooting began. Closed without intervention; instructed user to reopen if recurs.

history.issue_summary: Salesforce report scheduled email not sending
diagnosis_path: Confirmed user was not the report owner
Salesforce schedules require owner permissions
history.resolution: Transferred ownership to user; scheduled email began sending.

history.issue_summary: Slack workspace invite not received
diagnosis_path: Confirmed invite was sent to personal email pre-onboarding
Corporate email account not yet provisioned
history.resolution: Resent Slack invite once corporate email provisioned.

history.issue_summary: External monitor not detected on USB-C dock
diagnosis_path: Tested with another monitor — same dock port worked
Concluded original monitor cable was faulty
history.resolution: Replaced cable from IT supply.
